searchText: Hi team what’s the RPC for determining the longest chain? have any other clients pushed their first "post merge" release for Ropsten? aren't we planning on having a release shortly after merge where we lock in the ttd block number in our configs, after it's all finalized? Looks to have been included in geth 1.10.19: https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/25018/files i believe that was the placeholder we set prior to merge, not the block on which ttd was passed. Where does one get Goerli ETH for testing these days? Ideally something that doesn't require mainnet accounts or KYC. <@301186049323958275> I'll send you some, DM me your address 👍 Lots of errors with the latest nethermind master (11211f9246ae0ed1b85400c693cbd246550de91f) https://seamonkey.tech/ropsten/ropsten-lighthouse-nethermind.nethermind.log https://seamonkey.tech/ropsten/ropsten-prysm-nethermind.nethermind.log https://seamonkey.tech/ropsten/ropsten-teku-nethermind.nethermind.log
